title: Return through an invitation without rewriting identity
description: A signed-out commander with a saved identity and an admitted seat returns through the original invitation. Authentication resumes the campaign directly, with no identity resave. Missing and development-access-denied invitations provide explicit recovery routes without changing the saved identity.

steps.description: Prepare two independently authenticated commanders and two admitted seats through real UI, with fixed catalogue input and explicit emulator development access. Save the returning identity once, then sign out through the identity editor. This establishes an existing campaign; it does not claim illustrated admission or hosted Google acceptance.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open the original invitation while signed out.
steps.acknowledgement: The campaign asks for sign-in before exposing private information.
verifications: The private galaxy is absent while signed out.

steps.description: Continue to entry while retaining the exact campaign destination.
verifications: The campaign ID is preserved across the entry redirect.

steps.description: Authenticate with the saved account and resume the campaign directly.
steps.acknowledgement: The invited galaxy opens without an identity-editor round trip.
verifications: No identity resave or duplicate seat is required.

steps.description: Reload the resumed campaign with the same saved identity.
steps.acknowledgement: The authorized galaxy is recovered again.
verifications: Recovery leaves the original identity revision and receipt intact.

steps.description: Follow an invitation whose campaign is no longer available.
steps.acknowledgement: The unavailable-campaign error explains the missing destination.
verifications: All campaigns offers a usable remedy and identity is unchanged.

steps.description: Return to the campaign directory after the missing invitation.
steps.acknowledgement: The campaign directory loads and clears the missing-link error.
verifications: The existing saved identity remains unchanged.

steps.description: Remove this test account's emulator development claim to exercise a real authorization denial. The campaign, membership, history and identity records are not edited.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Follow the original invitation after development access is removed.
steps.acknowledgement: The development-access boundary denies campaign entry.
verifications: The denied view exposes no galaxy and leaves saved identity intact.

steps.description: Return to entry and clear the inaccessible invitation.
steps.acknowledgement: The entry surface is available again.
verifications: The denied campaign query is cleared without rewriting identity.
